0022600041.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-9, 0-5 at home) enter this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game on a three-game losing streak, 14th in the West and 8 games back in the Pacific. The Portland Trail Blazers (6-3, 5-1 on the road) are 8th in the West and 1.5 games back in the Northwest, though they have lost their last two, and they are missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle). The Kings trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 128-120 loss in Sacramento on Oct. 23, having lost all four meetings in 2025-26, and Sacramento will be without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee).
